title: [clinic · EX-20] Build a third bias probe
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-20` — Build a third bias probe](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-20-build-a-third-bias-probe.md) · difficulty 🔴

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** A probe that measures a property the judge is *supposed* to reward. Longer answers being scored higher is only bias if length is not actually better here.

**2.** Not holding content constant. If the probe changes what is said as well as how, it measures nothing.

**3.** Reporting the bias without asking whether it is *consistent*. A consistent bias cancels in a paired comparison; an erratic one does not.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-20]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
